verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair axis for a design platform, so it applies here. The evidence pack does not show that Canva offers either one. Every cited capability (Apps SDK, Connect/REST APIs, MCP server, SCIM, audit logs) integrates with or extends the Canva-hosted service, and those are adjacent features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
